description: Advice Slip is a free public API that returns random advice slips and supports search by keyword. Responses are available in JSON or JSONP; a separate daily RSS feed is also available. No authentication is required.
resolution_notes: description: auditor correct. Official docs at https://api.adviceslip.com document JSON and JSONP (callback query param) responses and a separate daily RSS feed; they do not document general XML responses. Original "JSON or XML" wording was wrong.
